findings.message: Self-closing <audio/> is invalid HTML. The browser will leave the tag open, swallowing all subsequent elements as invisible fallback content. This makes compositions INVISIBLE.
findings.fixHint: Change <audio .../> to <audio ...></audio>. Media elements MUST have explicit closing tags.

findings.message: <audio> has data-start but no id attribute. The renderer requires id to discover media elements, so this audio will be SILENT in renders.
